newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan March household spending up 5.8 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Japan March household spending up 5.8 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Japan's household spending in March rose 5.8 percent in real terms from a year earlier to an average 374,061 yen per household, the government's Management and Coordination Agency said on Tuesday.
In the fiscal year ended March 31, 1997, household spending fell 0.1 percent in real terms to an average 330,746 yen per household.
Household spending in the January to March period rose 2.0 percent in real terms to an average 333,383 yen per household, the agency said.
